title: Martinique village, Villa Nora police area (approx.): woman, 35, shot dead; police sergeant suspect later found dead, 21 Oct
summary: Police say a 39-year-old police sergeant stationed at Witpoort police station allegedly shot his 35-year-old wife dead on Wednesday 21 October in Martinique village, in the Villa Nora policing area; she was declared dead...
story: Police say a 39-year-old police sergeant stationed at Witpoort police station allegedly shot his 35-year-old wife dead on Wednesday 21 October in Martinique village, in the Villa Nora policing area; she was declared dead at the scene. He fled in his white Isuzu bakkie. At about 06:30 on Thursday 22 October police found the bakkie parked along the road in Botshabelo Section, Tom Burke policing area, about 100 metres from his body under a marula tree, with a gunshot wound to the head and his state-issued firearm next to him. An inquest docket was opened at Tom Burke. Motive unknown; domestic violence not ruled out (police spokesperson Col Malesela Ledwaba, via TimesLIVE). TimesLIVE's opening line says Abbotspoort village; its own report and police place the shooting in Martinique village. No one is named here. Two reports, both resting on police: TimesLIVE and Limpopo Chronicle. The suspect is a police officer. The pin is approximate (village level).
incident: Wed 21 Oct 2026; time not given (police, via TimesLIVE and Limpopo Chronicle)
location_note: Martinique village, in the Villa Nora police area (police, via TimesLIVE). No address. TimesLIVE's opening line says Abbotspoort village, but its own account places the shooting in Martinique; the owner chose Martinique (22 Oct). The pin is the Martinique village point on OpenStreetMap, inside the Villa Nora police precinct; approximate, village level (about 3 km). The suspect's body was found later at Botshabelo Section, Tom Burke police area; that place is not pinned.
